name: io.github.kshitij9896/cybersafe-mcp
title: CyberSafe MCP
description: Plain-language cybersecurity MCP for scam checks, link & breach scans, and daily safety tips.

tools.name: analyze_scam_message
tools.description:
Check a suspicious SMS, WhatsApp, email, or call script for scam red flags.

    Combines regional rule packs with an optional local HuggingFace AI scam model.

    Args:
        message: The exact text of the suspicious message or call script.
        channel: Where it arrived (e.g. 'SMS', 'WhatsApp', 'Email', 'Phone Call').
        region: Regional scam pack to apply ('all', 'global', 'india', or 'us_uk').

tools.name: check_url_safety
tools.description:
Check whether a suspicious web link looks like a phishing or malware URL.

    Combines local heuristic checks with live abuse.ch URLhaus lookups (when URLHAUS_AUTH_KEY is set).
    Never visits or opens the submitted link.

    Args:
        url: The web link to inspect (for example, 'https://example.com/login').

tools.name: check_email_breach
tools.description:
Check if an email address appeared in known public data breaches via XposedOrNot.

    Args:
        email: The email address to check (never logged or stored).

tools.name: get_latest_alerts
tools.description:
Get recent actively exploited security alerts from the free CISA KEV catalog in plain English.

    Args:
        limit: Number of alerts to return (1 to 15, default 5).
        consumer_only: If True, focuses on everyday devices & browsers (Apple, Google, Microsoft, etc.).
        keyword: Optional product or vendor filter (e.g. 'Chrome', 'iPhone', 'Windows').

tools.name: check_password_hygiene
tools.description:
Check password strength locally in memory without logging or sending it anywhere.

    Tip: Test a similar pattern rather than pasting your real banking password.

    Args:
        password_sample: The password or sample pattern to evaluate.

tools.name: get_daily_cyber_tip
tools.description:
Get one short, jargon-free daily cybersecurity tip.

    Args:
        category: One of 'phone', 'laptop', 'ai', or 'general'.
